t: Six things sought refuge from in one breath
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
p: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-bukhli wa-l-kasal, wa arzali-l-ʿumur, wa ʿadhābi-l-qabr, wa fitnati-d-dajjāl, wa fitnati-l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt.
m: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness and laziness, from the most wretched of old age, from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of the Dajjāl, and from the trials of life and death.
